amendments.reason: The contract puts sources in sources.yml and their column tests in schema.yml. dbt only accepts a source's column tests in the file that declares the source, and DbtTransform reports a source test under the source name (raw_shop) because attached_node is None and depends_on is sorted. Putting the tests on two thin models over raw_shop keeps them in schema.yml and reports them under customers/orders.
amendments.grounding: Ran DbtTransform with dbt-duckdb on a source-tested project: every test came back with table='raw_shop'; the relationships test's depends_on.nodes = [raw_shop.customers, raw_shop.orders]. The same check on the model-tested demo project returned customers/customers/orders with failures=1.
